parole.significato: The double crown of ancient Egypt, combining the white crown of Upper Egypt with the red crown of Lower Egypt, worn by…
parole.testo: From Ancient Greek ψχέντ (pskhént), from Late Egyptian pꜣ-sḫmtj (“the two powerful ones”), from pꜣ (“definite article”) + sḫmtj, dual of sḫmt (“powerful one”), from sḫm (“to be powerful, to have power over”).
